name: @opensa/perfect-vegetation-asi
description: Our own .asi for real GTA:SA 1.0 US: view-weighted tree-LOD impostor cards — each crossed card of a lod-trees impostor fades by how squarely it faces the camera, so the LOD shows ONE projection of the canopy from every angle instead of four stacked ones (lod-trees plan 013 step 04 on the sa target). Cross-compiled macOS→Win32 (MinGW-w64), tested under Wine.

scripts.build:asi: npm run gen && make clean && make APPLY=1
scripts.build:verify: npm run gen && make clean && make
scripts.build:debug: npm run gen && make clean && make APPLY=1 DEBUG=1
